hash: SHA256 of actual bytes; structured manifests use sorted keys and explicit domain tags

domains.source_snapshot_id: Complete frozen working-byte input manifest; includes source, programs and model inputs. A package addition may change this ID without changing kernel or runtime code.
domains.hardware_id: Provider flag, compatible, frozen bit/XSA/contract hashes and observed address/capability declaration. S8 and P8/W4 remain different hardware identities.
domains.uapi_id: Actual shared public UAPI headers and binary sizes/versions; private program schemas do not replace this identity.
domains.kernel_source_id: Actual Kbuild-selected driver/core/headers/generated legacy inputs and provider policy. Model packages are excluded; dependencies must be observed and hashed, never inferred only from a directory name.
domains.kernel_build_id: Kernel source identity plus actual compiler, configuration, generated headers, Module.symvers, builtin driver object, vmlinux, Image and DTB. New package-only network B must retain the exact kernel ELF hash.
domains.runtime_source_id: User-space owner, scheduler, adapters, operator implementations, loaders and compiled contracts. Model packages and raw request inputs have separate identities.
domains.program_elf_id: Actual RV32 ELF bytes and matching compiler/source/static audit receipt; not interchangeable with flat GPU CODE bytes.
domains.program_raw_id: Original machine-code payload bytes. Original IMAGE/P8 shaders are preserved and are not reassembled or rewritten.
domains.program_original_padded_id: Original IMAGE 64-byte alignment uses EBREAK words and retains its own SHA. The separate admitted 2048-byte object adds zero tail after that original padded payload; it never replaces original EBREAK words with zero.
domains.program_object_id: Actual admitted CODE object bytes. Original raw shaders and their 2048-byte zero-tail objects keep separate hashes; NN CODE guards/rodata follow their own frozen owned layouts.
domains.private_schema_id: Exact private argument layout and validated reference/address predicates; namespace/profile/program and complete provider identity are mandatory.
domains.catalog_entry_id: Full provider/hardware/program/schema/object/policy binding. A shared numeric program ID across namespaces or providers is never a cache identity.
domains.model_id: Frozen content manifest including graph, weights, operator identities, layout, precision, preprocessing and original numerical contract/history.
domains.input_id: Exact request bytes plus shape, dtype, layout, crop/normalization and preprocessing identities; filenames alone are insufficient.
domains.result_id: Output bytes with original execution scope, source/model/input/program/kernel/runtime/hardware identities, device epoch and raw evidence. Texture/display acceptance cannot upgrade its numerical or GPU scope.

address_domains.cpu_va: CPU virtual pointer: never substitute it for a DMA or GPU address.
address_domains.ps_dma: DMA API address constrained by the matched coherent pool and mask, not by CPU VA arithmetic.
address_domains.gpu32: Relocated 32-bit GPU address within the admitted object/view and frozen program range.
address_domains.pl_system40: PL/system address is independently range-checked; the frozen providers declare system PL base 0x500000000 and 2 GiB capacity. It is not the GPU32 base.

claim_policy.structural_elf_audit: Does not prove a new compilation or target execution.
claim_policy.matching_cross_compile: Requires actual commands/natural exits/compiler and full dependency closure; not image or board acceptance.
claim_policy.rv32_static: Requires actual entry/FCSR/rodata/stack/owned-state and machine-code binding; not physical PE execution.
